scenes.line: A benefit that pays your premiums if illness stops you working. A policy that has quietly matured. Money in one you thought had lapsed.

scenes.eyebrow: If anyone asks you to change it
scenes.line: So if someone asks you to replace this policy, the law is already on your side.
scenes.headline:
The law is already

scenes.eyebrow: The Insurance Act · Trinidad and Tobago
scenes.line: No agent, broker or sales representative may have you replace a long term policy without first discussing the advantages and the disadvantages with you. Ask for that in writing.
scenes.quote: An agent, agency, broker, brokerage or a sales representative shall not … cause a policyholder to replace a long-term insurance policy without first discussing the advantages and disadvantages of the discontinuance of the policy.
scenes.ask: So ask for it in writing. Anyone acting properly will give it to you.

scenes.line: That is what your own agent is for. Trained. Registered. Answerable for the advice they give.

rows.i: Not a friend of the family with a form. Someone who has had to earn the right.
No individual may act as an agent in Trinidad and Tobago unless they are registered.

rows.b: To you, and to the branch
rows.i: Their advice is on your file, and the branch stands behind it.
